title: North Miami Police Dept. Annual Report 2024
key_finding: North Miami's official 2024 police annual report identifies Cherise G. Gause as Chief of Police, describes a 24/7 patrol operation handling about 72,000 calls for service, and states that the Records Unit submits crime statistics to FDLE/FBI and transitioned all reporting systems to FIBRS and NIBRS in 2024.

title: Historic Crime Reductions in the City of North Miami: 2024 Marks Record-Breaking Achievements
key_finding: North Miami's January 9, 2025 police news release reports zero homicides in 2024, a 13 percent reduction in overall crime, a 41 percent reduction in violent crime, and the third-lowest Part I crime total in the city's history since 1979.

title: Contact the Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office
key_finding: Miami-Dade Sheriff's current patrol structure lists municipal districts for Miami Lakes, Palmetto Bay, and Cutler Bay, but not North Miami, which weighs against any claim that North Miami is an MDSO contract-policed city.

title: Municipal Police Stations
key_finding: Miami-Dade County's municipal police-stations dataset includes North Miami Police Department as a municipal police station and notes that most non-emergency calls are handled by the municipality.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists North Miami Police Department as a municipal row with population 65,089 and total index crime 2,489.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal offense report lists North Miami Police Department as a municipal row with population 60,175 and total index crime 2,023.

title: UCR Incident-Based Reports landing page
key_finding: FDLE states that Florida incident-based reporting data are available through downloadable FIBRS workbooks for the 2021-2024 and 2025 reporting cycles.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q2 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE FIBRS workbook found no North Miami Police Department row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q2 sheets, even though North Miami Beach Police Department rows appear in later sheets.
